Why NRT loses the route at 30 s

Monaco, GPS every 30 s. The 8 traces where the duckOSM HMM beats NRT + DTW most. NRT + DTW: for each gap between two GPS points, open-end graph-DTW of the road-interpolated track returns the 5 best routes (one for each end edge); a Viterbi over the whole trace chooses one route for each gap (DTW cost + length of the road connection between consecutive routes). Pick a trace; hover a point for its number and its error.
